protocol_metadata.about: Swell L2 Farm is an Ethereum-mainnet pre-launch deposit contract that allowed users to deposit liquid staking and restaking tokens (swETH, rswETH, and affiliated assets) to earn points and qualify for SWELL token airdrops ahead of Swell L2 launch. The protocol is built around Swell's ecosystem of liquid staking (swETH) and liquid restaking (rswETH) tokens, with the deposit contract acting as a fund-holding vault while users accrue rewards without bridging assets. Note: as of April 2026, Swellchain (Swell L2) has been sunset and users were required to withdraw funds before June 15, 2026; the protocol is evolving into 'Faro', a research-to-trade platform for Hyperliquid.
